_instructions: This template helps create wildcard collections for AI image generation.
Fill in all required fields marked with 'REQUIRED'.

metadata.theme: Brief description of the theme (e.g., 'Fantasy Environments')
metadata.author: Creator name (optional)

collection._comment: REQUIRED: Main collection data that will be imported
collection.name: REQUIRED: collection-name
collection.description: REQUIRED: Brief description of this collection's purpose and contents
_description_instructions: Help users understand when to use it

entries.notes: Optional: Generation context or usage notes

generation_prompt._comment: Optional: If using LLM generation, document the prompts used
generation_prompt.system_prompt: System-level instructions given to the LLM
constraints: Constraint 2: e.g., 'Focus on visual descriptions only'

examples.expected_output: Example of what the wildcard expands to

_minimal_example._comment: Minimal valid collection structure (remove metadata sections)

examples: elegant flowing red evening dress with lace details
casual distressed denim jacket with white t-shirt underneath
vintage classic muscle car with chrome accents and racing stripes
elegant flowing red evening dress with intricate lace details, silk fabric, and a dramatic train trailing behind
casual vintage distressed denim jacket worn over a simple white t-shirt, paired with comfortable jeans and sneakers
vintage classic American muscle car with gleaming chrome accents, bold racing stripes, and a powerful rumbling engine

_import_instructions.step1: Remove all fields starting with '_' (comments and instructions)
_import_instructions.step2: Fill in all REQUIRED fields in the 'collection' object
_import_instructions.step3: Add your entries to the 'entries' array
_import_instructions.step5: Validate JSON syntax (use a JSON validator tool)
_import_instructions.step6: Import using the Wildcards tab Import button
_import_instructions.minimal_structure: Only 'collection' object with name, category, description, and entries is required for import
